_meta.target: from-scratch SMB Deluxe (GBC) recreation, physics ported from SMB1 (NES)
_meta.primary_source_note: doppelganger's SMBDIS.ASM disassembly, fetched and grepped directly; line numbers refer to the raw blob (16351 lines) fetched 2026-08-28
_meta.framerate_assumed: 60 fps logical (NES NTSC 60Hz driving all frame-based constants below; GBC SMB Deluxe treated as the same logical 60fps -- actual hardware refresh differs slightly, ~59.7275Hz GB/GBC/GBA/SGB2 or ~61.17Hz SGB1, cosmetic only per unverified secondary source)

fixed_point.horizontal: signed byte, high nibble = whole pixels, low nibble = 1/16-pixel fraction (16 subpixels = 1 pixel). confirmed at smbdis.asm:7541-7556 (MoveObjectHorizontally).
fixed_point.vertical_speed: Player_Y_Speed is a signed WHOLE-pixel integer added directly to position each frame (not nibble-split).
fixed_point.vertical_accel: gravity/jump constants are added to a separate 1/256-pixel fractional accumulator (Player_Y_MoveForce); carry/borrow out of it changes Player_Y_Speed by +-1 whole pixel. confirmed at smbdis.asm:7704-7735 and 6014-6188.
fixed_point.friction_accel: FrictionData bytes are added directly (unsigned magnitude) to Player_X_MoveForce (1/256-subpixel accumulator) each frame; carry changes Player_X_Speed by 1 subpixel (1/16 px). confirmed at smbdis.asm:6227-6266.

_meta.see_also: games/mario/research/physics.md for full citations, per-value source lines, and prose explanation

max_speed.units: hex = raw signed byte (subpixels/frame, 16/px); px_per_frame = converted

pipe_intro.note: right value only found; used when GameEngineSubroutine==7 (player entrance)

acceleration.units: hex = raw byte added per frame to 1/256-subpixel accumulator
acceleration.source: smbdis.asm:6033-6034 (FrictionData); index mapping inferred from control flow at smbdis.asm:6139-6188

run_accel.when: on ground with B held + facing==moving dir, or RunningTimer already active, or airborne with |speed| >= 25 subpixels

high_speed_accel.when: RunningSpeed flag set OR |speed| >= 33 subpixels while not in the active-running case

skid_multiplier.source: smbdis.asm:6183-6187 (ASL/ROL doubles whichever tier value above applies when PlayerFacingDir != Player_MovingDir)

skid_instant_stop_threshold.note: below this speed while reversing input, speed is force-zeroed instead of skidding

air_control.note: same FrictionData/ImposeFriction logic applies airborne; the only restriction is you cannot newly enter the 'run' (0xE4) accel tier via a fresh B-press while airborne -- tier selection in air is purely from current |speed|, so momentum from takeoff carries over but a new run-tier cannot be earned mid-air.
air_control.release_deceleration: uses the same acceleration tables above (no separate release-only table); direction is determined by current speed sign when no L/R buttons held (smbdis.asm:6227-6234)

speed_tier_selection.basis: Player_XSpeedAbsolute (current horizontal speed magnitude, subpixels) checked at jump start

gravity_rising.units: px/frame^2 (raw value / 256, since Y_Speed is whole px)

variable_jump_height_rule.rule: while Player_Y_Speed < 0 (still rising): if A held this frame AND previous frame, keep using gravity_rising for this frame. The instant A is released (after rising >= 1px from jump origin), gravity_falling is applied immediately, cutting the jump short. Once Player_Y_Speed >= 0, gravity_falling always applies. There is no separate third 'held' gravity constant -- 'held' = gravity_rising for as long as held+rising, everything else = gravity_falling.

surface_clamp.note: prevents swimming above the water surface line

stomp_bounce.note_normal: goomba, green/red koopa, cheep-cheep, hammer bro, lakitu, bloober
stomp_bounce.note_shell: demoting a paratroopa to koopa, or kicking/re-stomping a shell

fireball.initial_vertical_note: downward immediately at launch, no upward arc

bounce_height_on_landing.note: background-collision re-bounce code not traced in this pass

star_invincibility_duration.tick_type: interval timer (21 raw frames per tick)

post_damage_invulnerability_duration.tick_type: interval timer (21 raw frames per tick)

red_koopa_edge_turning.mechanism: red koopa in normal state skips the background-collision state transition that lets other enemies walk off a ledge, falling through to the direction-inversion check instead -- this is what makes it turn around at ledges while green koopas walk off

hammer_bro.throw_interval_note: raw per-frame timer, not a 21-frame interval timer
hammer_bro.jump_vertical_speed_note: -3 used when hammer bro is in the upper half of the screen

lakitu.mechanism: LakituMoveSpeed is adaptively decremented toward zero based on horizontal distance to player (PlayerLakituDiff), not a fixed constant

flying_cheep_cheep_horizontal_speed_tabl.note: FlyCCXSpeedData not extracted in this pass

flying_cheep_cheep_bob.note: vertical bob driven by pseudorandom-difference lookup (PRandomSubtracter), not a clean sine formula; smbdis.asm:9922-9959

firebar_rotation.note: two distinct raw rotation rates (0x28 slower, 0x38 faster) across the 5 firebar variants (4 short orientations + 1 long); conversion to degrees/frame not derived in this pass

platform_lift_speeds.note: distinct routines exist for balance/vertical/large-lift/drop/horizontal platforms but per-type speed constants were not individually extracted

level_timer_tick_rate.note: displayed timer digit decrements once every 24 raw frames -- SMB1 in-game seconds run 2.5x faster than real time

death_animation.unknown: starting value of TimerControl at moment of death (fixes total animation length) not located

pipe_transition.note: reuses pipe-intro horizontal speed cap (0.75 px/frame, see horizontal_movement.max_speed.pipe_intro) but specific frame-length constants not extracted

smbd_gbc_specific_notes.note: this entire document is sourced from the NES SMB1 disassembly; no GBC SMB Deluxe disassembly was available/consulted

claims_found.claim: SMBD physics are 'somewhat tighter' than the NES original; example given is the wide gap in World 8-1 can be crossed without the coins above it in Deluxe but not in the original
SMBD uses a different engine with many glitches fixed (e.g. Minus World cannot be performed)
SMBD real hardware frame rate ~59.7275Hz (GB/GBC/GBA/GBP/SGB2) or ~61.17Hz (SGB1); claimed fastest version for speedrunning
claims_found.note: direct fetch of this page returned HTTP 403; content relayed only via search engine snippet, not independently re-verified

smbd_gbc_specific_notes.recommendation: treat ALL numeric physics constants above as must-measure against a real SMB Deluxe ROM before assuming NES-identical values, despite its 'faithful port' reputation

must_measure_summary: lakitu steady-state hover speed and follow distance
flying cheep-cheep horizontal speed table (FlyCCXSpeedData) and bob amplitude/period
platform/lift per-type speeds (balance, vertical, large lift, drop, horizontal)
exact total death-sequence and pipe-transition frame counts
any and all SMB Deluxe-specific numeric constants (this file is NES-sourced only)
